title: Fatigue, food and wrapping up
summary: Dorothy and the crew worry about Lloyd's meal and the long session before an upcoming tour.

blocks.x: Pick up the tempo, oh ask some questions.
I asked whether he’d asked all the questions.
Ask the questions! I’ll be real quick man, watch this! I’m gonna be lickety split!
Here’s the thing: We have received so much, and I mean...

I always tell those people when they come in and interview me for papers - I say, “You gonna stop and tell them we’re gonna stop the war machine now? And we’re gonna have Charles - put him on the front page?”
Oh I just know that Charles is gonna have to have something to eat.
I don’t need nothing to eat. I’m not hungry, I’m not hungry. Let them finish their work. Continue. Darling, I’m fine.
I mean, how do you feel?
I’m just taking it all in as best as I can. This is fantastic. But I - you kind of take it where you want to go.
We’ve been going for a long time.
And that’s something I want to be very respectful of to both of you, really.
No, I want to get this done cause I gotta get ready.
I’m in the state of nerves because I’m five-o-clock in the morning, we’re catchin’ a plane two days from now.
